candidates.description: risk-off regime switch: equal-weight robust ensemble (the frozen comparator members AO/AR_BIC/BVAR_MINNESOTA/RW) when the yield-curve probit recession probability (PROBIT_SPREAD, h=3) at the origin is >= 0.25, inverse-MSE ensemble otherwise
candidates.motivation: the inverse-MSE ensemble (ENSEMBLE_INVERSE_MSE) passed C1/C2/C5 but failed C4 by RMSE on W1_EXT (relative loss 1.0775; 1990-91 1.099, 2001 1.067); this is a new candidate designed after that result, disclosed as such; the old candidate's evaluation is neither retracted nor re-scored
candidates.design_disclosure: the risk-off rule uses the equal-weight robust ensemble, i.e. the same distribution as the frozen comparator in flagged origins, so C4 in those months is a not-worse test by construction; C6 remains the independent test and no ACTIVE claim is made
candidates.note: registered before its own evaluation; evaluation report protocols/regime_candidate_evaluation_report.json
